html:
Mui Ne Fishing Village, a hidden gem of Binh Thuan, is an ideal destination for travelers who wish to discover rustic beauty, simplicity, and the authentic daily life of local fishermen. This article serves as a comprehensive travel guide, covering the best time to visit, unique experiences, local cuisine, transportation, and accommodation tips helping you enjoy a complete and memorable journey in 2026.

With its rare, unpretentious charm, Mui Ne Fishing Village has long been a favorite stop for visitors to Binh Thuan. What makes this coastal village so attractive to travelers? Let’s explore the answer together in the guide below.

Overview of Mui Ne Fishing Village – Binh Thuan

Mui Ne Fishing Village is located about 22 km northeast of Phan Thiet city. Beyond its long stretches of white sandy beaches, the area is also known for its unique rocky coastline, creating a dramatic and picturesque natural landscape that attracts visitors from all over the world. The harmony between untouched coastal scenery and traditional fishing culture makes Mui Ne a must-visit destination when exploring Vietnam’s seaside regions.

More than just a residential area, Mui Ne Fishing Village is the heart of the local seafood industry. Every early morning, hundreds of fishing boats return after a long night at sea, bringing in baskets of freshly caught seafood and creating a vibrant, lively atmosphere. As sunset falls, anchored boats reflecting the golden light of dusk paint a peaceful and romantic scene moments that many visitors eagerly capture.

Visitors to Mui Ne Fishing Village can immerse themselves in fishermen’s daily routines, enjoy freshly prepared seafood at small seaside eateries, or participate in exciting water sports such as surfing and snorkeling. For those seeking tranquility, relaxing on clean beaches and admiring the blue sea and white sand is equally rewarding. Mui Ne Fishing Village truly offers an ideal blend of nature, culture, and relaxation.

The village’s history is deeply rooted in centuries-old fishing traditions. From a small coastal community, Mui Ne has grown into an important marine economic hub of Binh Thuan, renowned for its abundant seafood and traditional fishing techniques passed down through generations. Local residents continue to preserve their cultural values through daily life, festivals, and seaside architecture creating a vivid portrait of an authentic Vietnamese fishing village where time seems to slow down.

Best Time to Visit Mui Ne Fishing Village

The ideal time to visit Mui Ne Fishing Village is from November to April. During this dry season, the weather is sunny, warm, and pleasant, making it perfect for outdoor activities and beach relaxation. Average temperatures range from 25–30°C, allowing visitors to fully enjoy the coastal scenery.

November and December offer cooler air and minimal rainfall, ideal for sightseeing and seafood tasting. January and February mark the peak of the dry season, when beaches are at their most beautiful with clear water and gentle waves perfect for kite surfing, surfing, diving, or simply sunbathing. As this is also peak tourist season, early booking of accommodations and services is recommended.

If you are interested in cultural experiences, the Lunar August Whale Worship Festival (Cầu Ngư Festival) is a special highlight. This important fishermen’s festival prays for safety and abundant catches and features traditional rituals and folk performances, offering visitors a deep insight into local spiritual life.

Unique Experiences at Mui Ne Fishing Village

1. Explore the Lively Mui Ne Fish Market

Visiting the fish market at dawn is an unforgettable experience. As boats return to shore, fishermen unload fresh catches including fish, shrimp, squid, scallops, and crabs. Visitors can purchase seafood directly or enjoy simple yet delicious dishes such as grilled squid, steamed shrimp, and herring salad. Prices are affordable, and bargaining is common.

2. Check-in at the Peaceful Fishing Village

Colorful basket boats, fishermen mending nets, drying fish under the sun, and children playing on the sand create poetic scenes ideal for photography. Early morning and sunset are the best times for capturing stunning images.

3. Watch Breathtaking Sunrise and Sunset

Sunrise bathes the sea in golden hues, while sunset paints the sky with shades of orange, pink, and purple. These magical moments make Mui Ne a romantic destination for nature lovers and photographers.

4. Kayaking on the Sea

Kayaking allows visitors to glide across clear waters, explore rocky coastlines, and admire the village from a new perspective. Kayak rentals range from 100,000–200,000 VND per hour.

5. Enjoy Fresh Seafood by the Beach

Choose live seafood directly from fishermen and have it prepared at nearby eateries. Must-try dishes include fish hotpot, grilled squid with chili, and Mai fish salad.

6. Ride a Traditional Basket Boat

A basket boat ride offers a unique way to explore the sea and enjoy serene coastal views. Prices typically range from 50,000–100,000 VND per trip.

7. Experience Fishermen’s Daily Life

Visitors can join fishermen in net pulling, fishing, or cooking, and visit traditional fish sauce workshops to learn about local production methods.

8. Discover Traditional Dried Seafood and Fish Sauce Making

Mui Ne is famous for its fish sauce and dried seafood such as dried squid and yellowstripe scad. Many workshops welcome visitors for free tours and tastings.

9. Explore the Enchanting Sand Dunes (Red Sand Dunes)

Located nearby, the Red Sand Dunes change color throughout the day and are ideal for sand sliding and photography. Board rentals cost around 20,000–30,000 VND.

10. Visit Fairy Stream – Mui Ne’s “Hidden Paradise”

Fairy Stream features shallow waters flowing through red rock formations and white sand, creating a surreal landscape. The site is free to enter and best visited in the morning.

Must Try Local Dishes in Mui Ne Fishing Village

  • Charcoal-grilled whole fish
  • Beer-steamed shrimp
  • Scallops stir-fried with lemongrass and chili
  • Clam vermicelli soup
  • Mui Ne fish sauce
  • Mai fish salad
  • Grilled squid teeth
  • Seafood rice cakes (Bánh Căn)
  • Grouper hotpot

Transportation and Accommodation

Getting to Mui Ne

  • Coach: From Ho Chi Minh City, tickets range from 150,000–250,000 VND (4–5 hours).
  • Train: Travel to Phan Thiet Station, then take a taxi to Mui Ne.
  • Motorbike: Ideal for adventurous travelers.
  • Plane: Phan Thiet Airport (operational since 2026) offers direct domestic flights.

Where to Stay

  • Luxury resorts: 1,500,000–5,000,000 VND/night
  • Mid-range hotels: 500,000–1,000,000 VND/night
  • Homestays & guesthouses: 200,000–400,000 VND/night
  • Camping: For nature lovers

Travel Tips for Mui Ne Fishing Village

  • Bring sunscreen, hats, and sunglasses
  • Wear comfortable walking shoes
  • Carry cash for local markets
  • Respect local customs
  • Protect the environment
  • Book tours in advance during peak season

Mui Ne Fishing Village is truly a charming destination in Binh Thuan that should not be missed. Save this complete travel guide and start planning your journey today.
